not-found: Sorry the conversation you are looking for does not exist.
welcome2: Explore the wonders of ancient Egypt and uncover its secrets.
welcome3: Let's start planning an expedition by clicking on the map!
chooseExpedition: Here you can choose your expedition. Let's start with a short journey.
pyramidIntro: Look at these walls — so many numbers are missing!
pyramidIntro2: The secret: every number is the sum of the two below it.
pyramidIntro3: Use that, and we'll uncover what the ancient builders hid here. Good luck!
pyramidBlockedBlocks: Some blocks are blocked. They do not reveal their value.
pyramidBlockedBlocks2: We can try to calculate their value based on blocks around it.
pyramidBlockedBlocks3: And then use that number from memory.
pyramidBlockedBlocks4: You made it this far, you can do it!
expeditionCompleted2: A new expedition is now available.
collectionIntro: During our expeditions we found some items!
collectionIntro2: You can inspect them in your Collection screen.
collectionIntro3: Swipe/scroll the screen to the right to see your collection.
tombIntro2: Maybe we can translate the text using the hieroglyphs we found.
tombIntro3: We could even find a treasure here.
tombTutorial: See those symbol slots in the formulas? Place hieroglyphs from your collection below to fill them in.
tombTutorial2: The hint formulas will confirm when your assignments are correct — use them to find the right combination.
tombTutorial3: Once every slot is filled, a number lock appears. Solve the main formula to find the code and open the tomb!
hieroglyphUnlock: We have a special artifact — it lets us write on one of those sealed blocks!
hieroglyphUnlock2: Tap a glowing stone, then drag the artifact onto it to unlock it. One block per pyramid.
errorHighlightTutorial: That treasure we found has a handy trick — fill in a wrong answer and one mistake will glow red!
errorHighlightTutorial2: Only one block glows at a time, so it's still a challenge. But it helps narrow things down!
earlyFeedbackTutorial: See those checkpoint blocks? They turn green or red as you fill them in — live feedback!
earlyFeedbackTutorial2: Use them as anchors while solving. If one turns red, something nearby needs fixing.
notEnoughHieroglyphs: You can always stop this expedition by returning to the travel screen.
notEnoughHieroglyphs2: We can interrupt the expedition to search elsewhere for the hieroglyphs we still need to complete.
tombLoot: Wow, our first treasure! Well done!
mapPiece: We found a map piece! Together they lead to a hidden tomb.
mapPiece2: There's one waiting in each expedition at this difficulty — let's find them all!
mapPiece3: Check the journey list to see how many we've collected so far.
mosaicStarter: A cat in the doorway, and a snake leaving in a hurry. That was worth a bowl of milk.
mosaicStarter2: Egyptians loved cats for exactly this — they killed the snakes and the rats that got into the grain.
mosaicStarter3: They loved them so much they made one a goddess. Bastet. Protector of the house, the door, everyone asleep behind it.
mosaicJunior: Look at his hand — someone's showing him how to hold the pen.
mosaicJunior2: The bird-headed one is Thoth. Writing, counting, keeping the records — all his.
mosaicJunior3: The ibis we followed up the river? That's his bird. Every number we've filled into a wall belongs to him too.
mosaicExpert: That light isn't luck. They built the whole hall so it would land right there, on the right morning.
mosaicExpert2: The sun is Amun-Ra — the hidden one, and the light everyone can see. Both at once.
mosaicExpert3: Anyone who can measure the sky that precisely can measure anything. We've been solving their arithmetic all this way.
mosaicMaster: Green skin, and wheat growing straight out of him. That's on purpose.
mosaicMaster2: Osiris. He was killed, and put back together, and now he's what comes back every year when the river floods the fields.
mosaicMaster3: Down here that's the whole idea: dead isn't finished. Cheerful thought for a tomb, isn't it?
mosaicWizard: A heart on one side. One feather on the other. And it's balancing.
mosaicWizard2: The feather is Ma'at — truth, balance, the way things are supposed to be. Heavier heart than that feather and you don't go through the door.
mosaicWizard3: The jackal steadying the scale is Anubis. He's the one who walks you here.
mosaicFinale: Stand back a moment. Look at what we've been carrying up out of those pyramids.
mosaicFinale2: Every piece is part of him — the one who steadies the scale. He's been watching the whole way.
mosaicFinale3: That's his record of us. And I'd say it balances.
shopArrival: Ah, my stall! Let me lay out what I've picked up along the way.
shopArrival2: Rare finds cost the most, but I've also got everyday supplies — and I'll pay you for any trinkets you're carrying.
